name: HunyuanImage 3.0 (Instruct, Instruct-Distil)
purpose: Native multimodal autoregressive MoE for text-to-image; the Instruct variants (2026-01-26) add reasoning, prompt enhancement, image-to-image editing and fusion of up to three reference images.
